summary: Travis Kelce's joking February 2023 remarks on his New Heights podcast about needing to "find a breeder" to have kids resurfaced after a source told Yahoo Entertainment that he and Taylor Swift have talked about kids. Fans on X criticised the comments as sexist and doubted the claim given Swift's Eras Tour schedule. The article also recaps Swift attending Kelce's games and their public displays of affection.
one_line: Travis Kelce's old podcast joke about "finding a breeder" resurfaced amid his Taylor Swift romance, drawing criticism from fans on X.
key_facts: Travis Kelce, 34, plays for the Kansas City Chiefs and made the remarks in a February 2023 episode of his and brother Jason Kelce's podcast, New Heights.
The episode resurfaced after a source told Yahoo Entertainment that Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce "have talked about kids" within the next year.
In the episode, Jason Kelce asked their mother, Donna, which son she was rooting for as the Eagles and Chiefs prepared to meet in the Super Bowl.
Jason Kelce has three children with wife Kylie Kelce: Wyatt (four), Elliotte (two) and Bennett (seven months).
Travis Kelce joked: "I'm gonna find a breeder, and I'm gonna get kids so that mom can love me again."
Donna Kelce advised Travis to "Wait until you find the right person," and Jason replied "Please don't."
Fans on X criticised Travis Kelce's remarks as sexist, saying women are not "baby-making machines."
Fans also doubted the kids claim came from Swift's side, noting the Eras Tour is booked through November 2024.
On 22 October, Swift attended the Chiefs' win over the Los Angeles Chargers at Arrowhead Stadium, her fourth Kelce game.
Chariah Gordon, partner of Chiefs teammate Mecole Hardman Jr, posted an Instagram photo of Swift reaching to kiss Kelce's cheek.
Swift and Kelce were photographed on a date in New York City after surprise appearances on the season 49 premiere of Saturday Night Live.
Kelce said he placed his hand on Swift's bodyguard's back and did not push him: "he probably would have turned around and tased me."
